verdict.rationale: Preventing customer data from being used for model training is a fair privacy question for a cloud AI coding agent like Devin, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-usage controls. Self-hosted Outposts and the CLI sandbox concern where code runs and how it is isolated, not whether data is used for training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
